raw.query: SELECT lead_s, denominator_kind, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT window_name) AS windows, ROUND(AVG(cost_ratio)::numeric,6) AS avg_cost_ratio, ROUND(MIN(cost_ratio)::numeric,6) AS min_cost_ratio, ROUND(MAX(cost_ratio)::numeric,6) AS max_cost_ratio, BOOL_AND(is_current) AS all_current, BOOL_OR(denominator_window_mismatch) AS any_window_mismatch FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current = true AND policy = 'forecast' AND lead_s IN (15,30,45,165) GROUP BY lead_s, denominator_kind ORDER BY lead_s, denominator_kind
raw.observed: Current, window-matched forecast rows show broad per-window cost-ratio variation: for deployable_static_c8, lead 15 ranges 0.234899–2.923671 (avg 2.068125) and lead 165 ranges 0.234465–2.865983 (avg 1.960837); per_window_optimum ranges 0.937859–3.321308. All rows are current and have no denominator-window mismatch.
raw.evidence: The per-window cost ratios span roughly 0.23–3.32 across the 15–165 s issued-lead range, so cost is not essentially lead-invariant.
